title: What is included in the Free AI/Data Audit?
desc: We review your workflows, existing software, data readiness, integration constraints, and automation opportunities. The output is a practical recommendation for what to automate, modernize, build, or fix first.

title: Is this only for AI projects?
desc: No. The audit is useful for AI automation, software modernization, product engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, cloud DevOps, and technical planning.

title: Do we need clean data before talking to Mayurasoft?
desc: No. Data readiness is part of the audit. We help identify what data is available, what is unreliable, and what needs to improve before implementation.

title: What happens after the audit?
desc: You receive a written next-step recommendation. If there is a strong fit, Mayurasoft can help turn it into a scoped software, AI, data, or cloud implementation plan.

title: Who is this best for?
desc: Startup founders, SMB owners, CTOs, COOs, product leaders, and data leaders who want to make better technology decisions before committing budget.
